segments.comment: C-first A65 variation: a fresh Wizard wish creates an uncursed charged Bell of Opening, then applies the silver bell from slot o off the invocation level. The preserved first C attempt showed slot n was a writing tool; the corrected selector follows C's observed inventory label, before any JS comparison. This selects use_bell's findit integer-result path and its whole do_clear_area(findone) callback scan.
